scope: Current entry WAIT/POST task; complete known-issue inventory at review time, not proof of absence of undiscovered defects

issues.title: Later-entry opportunities are heavily thinned
issues.evidence: Initial generation inclusion is 1/2; later generations 1/32. Fitting/evaluation weights are hardcoded to 2/32.
issues.impact: Weights correct the declared sampling probabilities but do not replace the missing examples; later-entry states have disproportionate weight and limited distinct support.
issues.repair: Version the sampler and per-row inclusion probabilities; label more later generations from the neutral reference, preserving existing probe ages and outcomes.

issues.title: Few admissible, comparable labeled dates
issues.evidence: The expanding learner has 2–6 earlier label days. Earlier bootstrap labels use a different continuation; sealed and forward dates are deliberately excluded.
issues.impact: This is a prepared-dataset/date-design limit, not a rolling-window parameter accidentally discarding a large compatible history.
issues.repair: Build more same-contract labels on admissible earlier/development data; define a separate later validation block. Do not append bootstrap labels or consume reserved dates automatically.

issues.title: Reference states and operational scope are narrow
issues.evidence: One delayed probe per neutral POST/KEEP generation, primarily one empty rung while other slots follow the neutral prefix. Entry labels use 30 shares, six rungs and the first 60 seconds.
issues.impact: Repeated learned waits, simultaneous empty slots, selective-cancel re-entry, other order sizes and later contract phases are not established as representative.
issues.repair: Declare and sample additional joint-waiting/reference states without outcome selection; retain action identities and episode clusters. Separately test the intended size/phase.

issues.title: Entry loader does not opt in to pre-read boundary filtering
issues.evidence: The frozen dependency set contains SKIP_FOREIGN_PARTS=False and no assignment enabling it; all three entry builders call load_day directly.
issues.impact: Neighboring reserved files can be opened before row filtering. This is a read-boundary/lineage defect, not proof that their future prices entered eligible rows. Per-day clock estimates were also derived upstream and need separate lineage review.
issues.repair: Select allowed file hours before opening them in the entry path, audit upstream clock/source provenance, and require saved-row/label regression or superseding rebuilds.

issues.title: Raw-to-feature causality verification is incomplete for this entry pipeline
issues.evidence: Entry future checks perturb received histories and precomputed grid inputs. They cannot independently verify every upstream calculation. A separate stop-model audit recomputed a subset of upstream fields, not every entry field/population.
issues.impact: Passing downstream invariance is narrower than end-to-end verification of every input and nuisance clock.
issues.repair: Recompute upstream features from events known by the exact action time with planted early-clock failures; bind exact input definitions and source artifacts.

issues.title: Labels do not yet include the intended selective keeper
issues.evidence: POST, WAIT and NEVER are terminal portfolio differences under neutral KEEP and one frozen bootstrap entry continuation.
issues.impact: They are coherent standalone entry labels, but do not estimate the entry value under the intended combined entry/cancel strategy. The continuation is not assumed optimal.
issues.repair: After keeper/continuation identity is frozen, relabel both action branches under the same downstream policy. Keep entry WAIT/POST separate from cancel/keep.

issues.title: Sparse, heavy-tailed terminal targets include portfolio spillovers
issues.evidence: The existing first-fold noise audit used 4,040 training and 1,992 evaluation probes; terminal/external components contribute substantial variation. First-order decomposition keeps the terminal horizon.
issues.impact: Immediate entry signals may be weak relative to future policy/portfolio noise. It is not established that this noise is irreducible.
issues.repair: Measure fill opportunity, adverse movement and queue advantage separately and reconcile them to economic value; keep rare losses and no-fill actions. Do not train only on filled or ordinary-outcome rows.

issues.title: Unknown visible-depth queue can become zero in the fill simulator
issues.evidence: lv marks prices beyond the visible fifth level NaN; place converts nonfinite queue to zero before the next-frame adjustment. If it remains unknown, zero persists.
issues.impact: Model inputs preserve unknown queue, but labels may depend on an optimistic queue assumption. Current affected-label/P&L magnitude has not been measured.
issues.repair: Record unknown-queue statuses in label paths; evaluate conservative/optimistic queue bounds or an empirically justified model, then rebuild affected labels. Do not silently filter the population.

issues.title: Execution clocks and public-book fill rules are uncertain
issues.evidence: Current representation comparison reuses M50 labels; public snapshots, E2-estimated anchors and assumed Binance receipt latency limit timing precision. Untimed source legs remain explicitly excluded.
issues.impact: A deterministic learner can fit an assumed execution model whose fills differ from reality; missing executions may also affect source coverage.
issues.repair: Keep WS/E2 provenance, assess M0/M50/M250 and queue-rule sensitivity, and reconcile against recorded execution evidence before economic claims.

issues.title: Missing observations remain after representation changes
issues.evidence: Of 9,871 evaluation rows, 7,857 have partial liquidity history, 4,758 lack the start reference and 2,031 lack complete 250ms candidate history. Loader retains only five seconds of pre-window books.
issues.impact: Availability flags expose the missingness but cannot recreate known-time information. More training days do not restore those within-window observations.
issues.repair: Recover longer causal history/reference coverage only where captured and admissible; retain missingness/statuses otherwise. Audit the frame-weighted liquidity estimator separately.

issues.title: Available public signals are incomplete proxies
issues.evidence: Top-five depth and pending/shrink increments do not identify exact public queue, cancellations versus trades, a causal venue execution stream, or deep Binance L2.
issues.impact: The feature catalog cannot guarantee sufficient information for fill/adversity timing, however well normalized.
issues.repair: Reconstruct additional causal flow only from receipt-timed records; quantify incremental contribution and observation limits instead of assuming a larger catalog fixes prediction.

issues.title: Learner complexity and regularization may be unsuitable for support
issues.evidence: CONDITION has 351 named fields including aliases, with weight-only effective training counts about 523–1,587 per side/fold. The pinned learner is 200 boosted trees, 31-leaf maximum, no explicit L2.
issues.impact: Overfitting or poor conditional estimation is plausible; feature count is not independent dimensionality. Earlier compact/ridge candidates did not solve the task.
issues.repair: After label/support fixes, test a small predeclared regularization/complexity comparison on development data; flag changes from the pinned fairness baseline.

issues.title: Stable timing and economic selection are not demonstrated
issues.evidence: CONDITION reduces bid timing error 1.43% but increases ask error 0.95%; both trail prior-mean/price-rung baselines. None of six economic checks passes. Some historical feature relationships change sign.
issues.impact: A lower distribution distance or better absolute-POST score is insufficient evidence of useful WAIT/POST timing; the cause of side/date differences remains open.
issues.repair: Retain separate bid/ask evaluation, decision calibration, per-condition support and matched economic controls. Do not select a common representation solely on pooled error.

issues.title: Training-history effect and generalization have not been isolated
issues.evidence: Growing folds test different days; no fixed-evaluation learning curve exists. These dates have been used repeatedly. Actions within market/day share information/outcomes; weight ESS does not remove dependence.
issues.impact: We cannot attribute failure to short history or call a selected historical improvement forward validation.
issues.repair: Compare nested histories on identical evaluation actions, separately vary later-state sampling, use day-level uncertainty where justified, then freeze for later untouched-day validation under the program rules.

issues.title: Combined strategy and net value are not established
issues.evidence: This representation study performs local prediction/selection checks only, with gross terminal labels. No combined selective-keeper portfolio, fees/rebates or measured runtime acceptance is shown.
issues.impact: Local scores cannot establish quote residence, inventory risk, full-policy profitability or operational speed.
issues.repair: After credible local signal, evaluate the actual combined strategy with its intended costs, clocks, order sizes and queue/age breakdowns; keep research and live execution separate.

loader_opt_in_occurrences: if SKIP_FOREIGN_PARTS and not part_allowed(fn, day):
fixed_or_bypassed: Audited units, side signs and denominators passed.
Start-price mask repaired in features and continuation; original labels rebuilt.
Client-known ladder state and portfolio accounting checks implemented.
Inverse inclusion weighting applied to fitting and scoring.
New representation retains absolute liquidity/risk and missing/support statuses.
Old CLEAN preprocessing removal/scaling defects do not enter RAW/RELATIVE/CONDITION.
limitations: No new historical replay or raw-data content read in this review; source-code and existing-receipt review only.

Directory inventory exposed forward-family date names before the stricter P9 rule was reread; no forward file content/model outcome was inspected. This metadata exposure is recorded and no fresh-validation eligibility is asserted.
Current unknown-depth queue effect and pre-read-filter regression are not quantified by this review.
The sampler specification is a proposed repair, not an implemented or performance-validated fix.
